criteria.criterion: 1) 硬件规格对比表 (Hardware specification comparison table)
criteria.notes: Matrix covers 15 devices: 8 NVIDIA variants (RTX 4090/4090D, RTX 5090, RTX 6000 Ada, A100 SXM4/PCIe, H100 SXM5/PCIe, H200), 1 AMD (MI300X), 2 Apple (M4, M4 Max), 1 SambaNova (SN3000 rack), 1 Groq (LPU hosted), 1 Cerebras (WSE-3 hosted). Each entry includes: memory_gb, memory_type, bandwidth_gb_s, compute_fp16_tflops, llm_7b_tok_s, llm_70b_tok_s, price_usd, power_watts, form_factor, nvlink.

criteria.criterion: 2) LLM推理性能基准(统一方法论) (LLM inference performance benchmark with unified methodology)
criteria.notes: T02 produces comprehensive benchmark methodology document covering: (a) standard test matrix with 5 model/quantization/context combinations, (b) 4 measurement metrics (decode tok/s, prefill tok/s, $/tok, ms/tok), (c) 6 normalization rules including methodology tags, (d) framework differences documented, (e) known limitations (FP8 gap, quantization accuracy, memory-bound vs compute-bound, KV cache). T03 applies this methodology to all 15 devices with source attribution.

T04 produces: (a) 7B $/tok ranking (14 entries, RTX 5090 #1 at $0.34/tok), (b) 70B $/tok ranking (10 entries, Apple M4 Max #1 at $81.82/tok), (c) best value recommendations (RTX 5090 for 7B, MI300X for 70B), (d) best performance recommendations (RTX 5090 for 7B, H200 for 70B), (e) 8 detailed caveats including benchmark methodology variance, retail price premium, and multi-GPU scaling.

criteria.criterion: 4) 新兴架构评估 (Emerging architecture assessment)
criteria.notes: T06 independently verifies 3 emerging architectures: (a) Groq LPU — confirmed ~1,000 tok/s/user with independent third-party sources (AnandTech, introl.com, memu.pro), confidence 0.80. (b) Cerebras WSE-3 — official 750 tok/s confirmed, stage 02 peak claims (1,800-3,000) identified as inflated, confidence 0.70. (c) SambaNova SN3000 — no independent benchmarks found, vendor-only claims, confidence 0.55. All 3 architectures share on-chip SRAM advantage but lack GPU flexibility.

criteria.criterion: 5) 边缘方案能力边界 (Edge solution capability boundaries)
criteria.notes: T05 evaluates 5 edge devices: Apple M4 (24GB, 35-70 tok/s 8B), Apple M4 Max (128GB, 70+ tok/s 8B, 15 tok/s 70B), NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB, 120 tok/s 7B), NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (8GB, 10-28 tok/s 1B-3B), NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada (48GB, 200 tok/s 7B, 20-30 tok/s 70B). Gap analysis identifies 5 fundamental gaps vs datacenter GPUs: model size, throughput, multi-stream, flexibility, reliability.

T07_decision_framework.notes: Not a direct success_criteria but produced as synthesis of all 5 criteria. Includes weighted scoring (8 criteria, 0.05-0.20 weights), per-GPU scores with breakdowns, decision tree by model size, and recommendations for 7 different scenarios.

T01_sambanova_research.notes: Independent research on SambaNova SN3000 — feeds into T06 emerging architecture assessment and T03 hardware matrix.

summary: All 5 success_criteria from stage 02.5 are fully covered by stage 03 artifacts. T02+T03 cover benchmark methodology and hardware specs. T04 covers cost-performance. T05 covers edge boundaries. T06 covers emerging architectures. T07 provides synthesis/decision framework. T01 provides supplementary SambaNova research.
